question: Grove Avocado Oil acquired by company
markdown:
Grove Avocado Oil (operated by Avocado Oil New Zealand Limited)
has not been publicly acquired by a larger parent corporation
; rather, Grove itself is an independent producer that expanded by acquiring local assets, such as purchasing local New Zealand food brand Fressure Foods.
Amazon.com
Company Status
Ownership:
Independently operated by New Zealand growers in the Bay of Plenty.
Operations:
Continues to produce cold-pressed extra virgin avocado oil under its own name.
Internal Expansion:
Acquired Fressure Foods and its guacamole processing equipment in March 2022 to expand into local guacamole production.
